children: Novo Nordisk (NOVO_B) projects over DKK150 billion in new pipeline sales by 2035 to offset potential Wegovy exclusivity losses and support long‑term revenue.
NOVO_B: mixed late-stage CagriSema data — two obesity trials missed targets; diabetes trial showed ~12.4% average weight loss. Company filed U.S. marketing application in December.
NOVO_B: oral Wegovy made ~33% of US obesity prescriptions; Novo captured >80% of new oral obesity scripts. Oral pill sales ~5.5bn DKK (~$843m) in H1.
NOVO_B fell ~0.7% intraday after investor day, earlier swinging ~8%. Traders cite 2027 price pressure worries, skepticism on CagriSema launch, and upcoming clinical readouts as catalysts.
Novo Nordisk (NOVO_B) is diversifying as GLP‑1 competition grows and semaglutide faces an upcoming patent cliff; moves aim to address competition and patent expiry risks for semaglutide.
Novo Nordisk A/S Sponsored ADR Class B (NOVO_B) is pursuing diversification by targeting bolt-on acquisitions and accelerating development of treatments for heart, liver, and blood disorders.
Novo Nordisk (NOVO_B) licensed rights from China’s United Laboratories to add a triple-hormone weight-loss candidate to its early-stage obesity pipeline, expanding its obesity drug program.
Novo Nordisk (NOVO_B) explores entering the hair‑loss market using expertise from its GLP‑1 drugs; company says no final decision yet on pursuing hair‑loss first.
Real-world study of 3,011 patients on Novo Nordisk’s oral Wegovy (NOVO_B): recent weight gain, lower baseline weight and dose escalation by day 60 linked to >10% weight loss within 180 days.
Novo Nordisk (NOVO_B) met Beijing officials, including vice commerce minister Ling Ji, to discuss regulatory steps to boost stability and clarity for foreign-invested firms operating in China.
